arabic text: YA HUSAIN (AS) YABNA -ZAHRA (AS) HUSSAIN (AS)\nYA MOLAANA HUSAIN (AS) YA SAAR ALLAH HUSSAIN (AS)
english translation text: O Hussain, son of Zahra; O our\nMaster Hussain; O blood of God, Hussain.

arabic text: TERI QASAM MOLA\nTERA YEH GHAM MOLA\nHOGA NA KAM MOLA
english translation text: By your oath, Maula,\nthis grief of yours, Maula,\nwill never diminish, Maula.

arabic text:
AE MERA MOLA MERA AQAA SHAH-E-KARB-O-BILAA
DONO AALAM MAIN NAHI KOI BHI TERE JAISE
TERE QADMON SE HAI JO KHAK BANI KHAK SHIFA
US PE KARNA NE MUJHE JAAKE KHUDA KO SAJDA
HAI YE SADA LAB PAR
DEKH LEIN TERA DAR
TERE YE SAB NOKAR
english translation text:
O my Maula and Master, King of Karbala,
there is none like you in either world.
The dust beneath your feet became healing dust.
Let me go there and prostrate to God upon it.
This remains upon my lips:
may I behold your door,
for we are all your servants.

arabic text:
CHAAND JAB MAH-E-MUHARRAM KA NAZAR AATA HAI
HAR AZAADAR KA GHAR KARBALA BAN JATA HAI
JAB TERA CHAHAANAY WALA YEH KHABAR PAATA HAI
AANKH SE AANSU TERE NAAM PE BARSATA HAI
BICHHTA HAI FARSH-E-GHAM
KARTE HAIN JAB MAATAM
KEHTE HAIN ROKAR HUM
english translation text:
When the moon of Muharram appears,
every mourner's home becomes Karbala.
When your lover receives this news,
tears fall from the eyes in your name.
The mourning floor is spread;
when we perform matam,
we say while weeping:

arabic text:
ARBAEEN PAR TERE PARCHAM KE TALE AATE HAIN
NANGE PAON TERE ZAWAAR CHALE AATE HAIN
RAAH KI KHAK JO CHEHRON PE MALE AATE HAIN
TERA SADQA TERE TUKDON PE PALE AATE HAIN
JAZBA KAHIN AISA
HAM NE NAHI DEKHA
ISHQ HAI YE TERA
english translation text:
On Arbaeen, they come beneath your standard,
walking barefoot as your visitors.
They rub the road's dust upon their faces,
raised through your charity and sacrifice.
Nowhere have we seen
such devotion;
it is your love.

arabic text:
HUR (AS) BANA DETA HAI TU JIS PE NAZAR KARTA HAI
EK MAANGE TU ATAA SAAT PISAR KARTA HAI
BAS TERA NAAM HAI JO SEENON MAIN GHAR KARTA HAI
KHUN BAN KAR MERI NASS NASS MAIN SAFAR KARTA HAI
english translation text:
Whomever you look upon, you can make a Hurr.
When one asks, you grant seven sons.
Your name alone makes a home within the chest
and travels through every vein like blood.

arabic text: BAAB-E-ATA HAI TU\nDIL MAIN BASA HAI TU\nNAZ-E-KHDA HAI TU
english translation text: You are the gate of generosity;\nyou live within the heart;\nyou are God's pride.

arabic text:
DO MUHARRAM KO TU JAB KARBALA MAIN PONCHA
YE HABEEB (AS) IBN-E-MAZAAHIR KO LIKHA KHAT MOLA
JALD AAJAAO MERE DOST KI HUM HAIN TANHA
HAAE JIS WAQT YE KHAT IBN-E-MAZAAHIR KO MILE
USNE WO KHAT KHOLA
PARH KE BOHOT ROYA
LIKHA YE JAB DEKHA
english translation text:
When you reached Karbala on the second of Muharram,
you wrote a letter to Habib ibn Mazahir:
come quickly, my friend, for we are alone.
When that letter reached Ibn Mazahir,
he opened it,
wept greatly,
and saw these words:

arabic text:
YABNA AL-ZAHRA (AS) HUSAIN (AS)
TUJH PE AASHOOR KE DIN KIYA KIYA QIYAMAT GUZRI
DEKHI AKBAR (AS) KE KALIJE MAIN SANAA TOOTI HUI
ALI (AS) ASGHAR (AS) KA GALA BAZOOYE ABBAS (AS) JARI
DONO KO TEER SE HOTE HUE DEKHA ZAKHMI
AISA SAFAR TERA
KAT GAYA SAR TERA
LUT GAYA GHAR TERA
english translation text:
O son of Zahra, Hussain.
What Judgement Days passed over you on Ashura:
you saw the spear broken within Akbar's heart,
Ali Asghar's throat and Abbas's arms
both wounded by arrows.
Such was your journey:
your head was severed,
and your home was plundered.

arabic text:
DEEN-E-HAQ PAR TERA EHSAN HI AISA HAI HUSAIN (AS)
CHAUDA SADIAAN HUIN GHAR GHAR TERA CHARCHA HUSAIN
TERE DAM SE HI NAAMAAZ AUR YE SAJDA HAI HUSAIN (AS)
DEKHO ZEESHAN O KARIM AAJ BHI ZINDA HAI HUSAIN (AS)
KAAM TERA MOLA
KOI NAHI BHULA
SAB NE YEHI BOLA
english translation text:
Your favour upon the true faith is so great, Hussain.
Fourteen centuries have passed, yet every home speaks of you.
Through you alone prayer and prostration remain alive.
See, Zeeshan and Karim—Hussain still lives today.
Your deed, Maula,
no one forgot;
everyone said the same.
